reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness web plugin whose primary purpose is adding settings pages for managing MCP server configurations and uploading Skills, with documented filesystem writes for uploaded skills.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面添加 MCP 服务器和 Skills 设置页面，用于管理服务器配置并上传技能文件。
summaries.en: Adds MCP Servers and Skills settings pages to the DeepSeek Harness web interface for managing server configurations and uploading skill files.

capabilities: Adds MCP Servers and Skills settings pages to the DeepSeek Harness web UI
Lists, adds, edits, and deletes external MCP server configurations
Uploads skill folders containing SKILL.md and writes them under $DSH_HOME/skills/<name>/SKILL.md
